trades.reasoning: Full multi-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) meets the strict bar for a high-conviction entry even though broader market direction is unclear today.

decisions.briefing: Market direction data was unavailable today (NASDAQ/S&P flat), so we held back from aggressively deploying all open slots. We added one high-conviction position, IRTC, which showed complete technical confirmation across RSI, MACD, price trend, and volume, while leaving cash and slots in reserve until a clearer market signal emerges.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market data feeds were unavailable today, so NASDAQ and S&P 500 moves could not be confirmed, leaving overall direction uncertain. In the absence of a clear macro signal, individual stock-level technical setups become the primary basis for decisions. IRTC stood out with full confirmation across momentum, trend, and volume indicators, making it a reasonable selective buy despite the unclear broader tape.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤數據來源暫時無法取得，納斯達克與標普500的實際走勢未能確認，整體市場方向並不明朗。在缺乏明確總體訊號的情況下，個股層面的技術面表現成為決策的主要依據。IRTC在動能、趨勢及成交量指標上均獲得完整確認，因此在大盤不明朗的背景下仍屬合理的精選買入標的。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade when several independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and volume — all point the same direction at once. This reduces the chance of being fooled by a single false signal, especially useful when broader market direction is unclear.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有在多個獨立指標——例如RSI、MACD、價格趨勢及成交量——同時指向同一方向時才進行交易。這樣可以降低被單一錯誤訊號誤導的風險，在大盤方向不明朗時尤其有用。
